llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed mkts.io market-data integration with user-confirmed account record changes and no hidden install or execution behavior.

dimensions.detail: Network access to mkts.io and optional API-key use are necessary for the integration, and the skill discloses transmitted request data, private financial records, and rate-limit behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single SKILL.md requiring curl and optionally MKTS_API_KEY; there are no executable scripts, package installs, or background setup steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Sensitive operations are scoped with explicit instructions to default to read-only behavior, show exact payloads, require immediate confirmation for POST/PATCH/DELETE, resolve IDs before deletion, and treat external content as untrusted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Portfolio holdings, journal text, watchlists, generated portfolio images, and registered API keys can persist externally, but the artifact clearly discloses this and requires user confirmation for mutations or local image writes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities match its stated purpose: market quotes, screening, financial research, and optional portfolio, journal, and watchlist management through mkts.io.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending market queries and any portfolio, journal, or watchlist data you choose to use to mkts.io. Keep MKTS_API_KEY in the environment only, review every proposed write/delete payload carefully, and avoid putting secrets or unnecessary personal details in notes or natural-language queries.
